item.g:title: Black Coral Zari Ensemble
item.g:description: A graceful Kashmiri pheran detailed with antique-gold Zari embroidery. The restrained surface work and easy line make it suitable for celebrations, gifting and winter evenings.

item.g:title: Ivory Antique Gold Zari Pheran

item.g:title: Chinar Naqashi Copper Ewer
item.g:description: A sculptural copper ewer with a long pouring lip, curved handle and chinar-inspired engraved surface. Its warm antique finish makes it a graceful table object or meaningful wedding gift.

item.g:title: Chinar Naqashi Lidded Serving Dish
item.g:description: A round copper serving dish paired with a matching domed lid. Dense engraved leaf work continues across the interior and cover for a ceremonial, heirloom-led presentation.

item.g:title: Chinar Naqashi Copper Keepsake Box
item.g:description: A low-footed copper keepsake box with a removable engraved lid and gently scalloped edges. Designed for jewellery, letters or gifting, with natural variation in every hand-finished surface.

item.g:title: Chinar Naqashi Copper Bowl Trio
item.g:description: Three graduated copper bowls brought together as a coordinated serving or display set. Wide polished rims balance the darkened chinar and floral engraving around each rounded form.

item.g:title: Kashmir Naqashi Copper Samovar Set
item.g:description: A statement copper samovar with a domed lid, pedestal warming base, serving tap and two matching cups. The richly engraved set is made for ceremonial tea moments and distinguished gifting.

item.g:title: Birdsong Carved Walnut Keepsake Box
item.g:description: A rectangular walnut keepsake box covered with deep openwork carving of birds, flowers and curling leaves. The fitted lid and warm hand-rubbed finish make it an heirloom home object for letters, jewellery or meaningful gifts.

item.g:title: Gul Carved Walnut Lidded Box
item.g:description: A round lidded walnut box with layered leaf carving around the top and a continuous floral band around the body. Its generous form suits dry keepsakes, jewellery or a considered wedding gift.

item.g:title: Chinar Carved Walnut Wall Clock
item.g:description: A statement wall clock framed by hand-carved scrolling leaves and warm natural walnut grain. A quiet clock movement and clear hour markers bring daily function to an ornamental Kashmiri woodcraft piece.

item.g:title: Iris Carved Walnut Wall Panel
item.g:description: A tall arched walnut panel carved with a balanced flowering iris motif. Designed as a slim wall or shelf accent, its restrained relief lets the natural grain remain part of the composition.

item.g:title: Tree of the Valley Chinar Plaque
item.g:description: A freestanding chinar-leaf plaque carved with a branching tree and textured foliage. The sculptural outline gives the small object presence on a console, bookshelf or gifting table.

item.g:title: Gul Carved Walnut Hair Comb
item.g:description: A crescent-shaped wide-tooth walnut comb finished with a hand-carved floral vine. Smooth rounded teeth and a polished grip make it a useful personal object with the warmth of Kashmir woodcraft.

item.g:title: Noor Chinar Papier-Mache Keepsake Box
item.g:description: A scalloped charcoal keepsake box covered in antique-gold chinar leaves and fine vine borders. The compact lacquered form is made for jewellery, small letters or considered gifting.

item.g:title: Saffron Garden Papier-Mache Box Pair
item.g:description: A coordinated pair of rounded keepsake boxes: one ivory garden pattern and one garnet chinar design. Their different sizes make the set useful for jewellery, mementos and wedding gifts.

item.g:title: Zoon Garden Papier-Mache Floor Vase
item.g:description: A tall floor vase with a long neck, generous shoulder and dense painted garden. Muted saffron, forest and rust details give the sculptural form a warm, collected character.

item.g:title: Guldaan Papier-Mache Decorative Ewer
item.g:description: A lidded decorative ewer with a curved black handle, pouring spout and pedestal foot. Fine floral painting wraps the rounded body for an expressive shelf or table object.

item.g:title: Nigeen Miniature Papier-Mache Trinket Box
item.g:description: A small round trinket box painted with coral and dusty-blue flowers around a central medallion. Its quiet ivory ground and fine brushwork suit rings, small keepsakes and guest gifting.

item.g:title: Chinar Garden Papier-Mache Box Quartet
item.g:description: Four graduated round and oval boxes brought together as a coordinated gift set. Each charcoal-lacquered lid carries a different floral medallion in muted turquoise, rust and gold.

item.g:title: Crescent Willow Carry Basket
item.g:description: A sculptural crescent basket whose broad curved rim becomes the handle. The close honey-toned weave is strong enough for daily carrying and elegant enough to leave on display.

item.g:title: Valley Willow Picnic Basket
item.g:description: A low oval picnic basket with a tall arched handle, braided rim and fitted split lids. Its generous interior is designed for relaxed outings, gifting or useful home storage.

item.g:title: Lidded Willow Storage Basket
item.g:description: A round woven storage basket framed by dark walnut-toned bands and a flat handled lid. The calm two-material finish works naturally in bedrooms, studies and living spaces.

item.g:title: Willow and Walnut Tissue Box Cover
item.g:description: A rectangular tissue box cover that pairs close willow weaving with a dark wooden top and fine braided edges. It brings useful craft detail to a bedside, desk or washroom.

item.g:title: Valley Stripe Willow Market Basket
item.g:description: An open oval market basket with two integrated handles and restrained forest and terracotta woven bands. The sturdy braided rim makes it practical for errands, storage and gifting.
